recipe.name: Asparagus and Prawns with Egg Yolk and Vinegar Dressing (Kimizu)
directions: Steam prawns in a small amount of water and sake, then peel the shells off.
Trim hard part of the asparagus stems at lower end and blanch them.
Cut the asparagus into 3-4cm/1⅛-19⁄16″ long pieces. Halve prawns.
Mix the _Kimizu_ ingredients in a heat-safe glass bowl or a metal bowl.
Place the bowl in a pot of simmering water and mix the sauce until it thickens.
Put the sauce in ice water to quickly cool it down.
Place asparagus pieces and prawns on a serving plate. Pour the sauce over.
Remove the hard part of the asparagus stems at lower end.
Boil water in a saucepan, add a pinch of salt and par boil asparagus for 30 seconds to 1 minute. Drain.
Cut the asparagus stems into 3-4cm/1⅛-1 9⁄16” long pieces.
Remove the head of the prawns and de-vein (note 5).
Put prawns, sake and water into a pot and steam the prawns for 3-4 minutes over medium heat with a lid on. Let them cool and peel the shell.
Halve each prawn perpendicular to the spine (note 1).
Put the egg yolk in a heat proof glass bowl (preferred) or a metal bowl and mix well with a spatula.
Add sugar to the bowl and quickly mix well. Then add salt and mirin to the bowl. Mix well ensuring that the mixture is smooth with no lumps (note 6).
Add vinegar and mix well.
Put water in a shallow pot or a saucepan that can fit the bowl inside and bring it to a boil. The depth of the water should be about 5cm/2” deep (note 7).
Reduce the heat to the lowest so that the water does not even simmer, then place the bowl inside the pot/pan (note 8).
Mix the _kimizu_ mixture gently with the spatula for 4-5 minutes. As the yolk is heated up, the mixture starts getting thicker.

When the yolk becomes creamy but still runny, transfer the bowl from the water bath to a bowl with ice water and continue to mix. The sauce will thicken to the consistency of slightly runny mayonnaise.
Put the asparagus and the prawns on a serving bowl, clustering each ingredient together.
Pour the _kimizu_ over the asparagus and prawns. It will look nice if you cover part of these ingredients with _kimizu_ (see the photo).
